title: Portrait and Inheritance
author: Odile Eastwick
blurb: Theo Whitlock, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
